description: This file defines a handler class for processing 'create quote' commands within the Fineract interoperation module. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, is annotated as a service, and delegates quote creation to the InteropService.

classes.name: CreateInteropQuoteHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles 'CREATE' commands for quotes in the Fineract interoperation module, delegating operation to InteropService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command by calling createQuote on the InteropService.
